cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el total de ingresos registrados en caja en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cm.amount), 0) AS total FROM cash_movement cm WHERE cm.type = 'INCOME' AND cm.created_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND cm.created_at < DATE '2026-05-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cm.amount), 0) AS total_ingresos FROM public.cash_movement AS cm WHERE cm.type = 'INCOME' AND cm.created_at >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND cm.created_at < CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántas sesiones cerradas tuvo cada caja en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, COUNT(*) AS sesiones FROM cash_session cs JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND cs.closed_at < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY sesiones DESC LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se registró en ventas en efectivo y otros medios por caja en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, SUM(cs.sales_cash) AS ventas_efectivo, SUM(cs.sales_other) AS ventas_otros FROM cash_session cs JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND cs.closed_at < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY caja LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, COALESCE(SUM(cs.sales_cash), 0) AS total_efectivo, COALESCE(SUM(cs.sales_other), 0) AS total_otros_medios FROM public.cash_register AS cr JOIN public.cash_session AS cs ON cs.cash_register_id = cr.id WHERE DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', cs.opened_at) = CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY cr.name ORDER BY caja LIMIT 50
